thread:
ajay: FYI — getting a P1 from HelioHealth: org admins can't create API keys or access model list after today's RBAC refactor :lock:

maria: ack. any quick repro steps / org id?
ajay: they reported console shows "You do not have permission to view models" and billing page 403. Org: helio-23. Happened immediately after 12:15 deploy.

ops-bot: deploy completed: rbac-refactor v3.2.1 by sam at 2026-03-20T12:15:03Z :white_check_mark:

sam: rolling restart was a small schema attr rename (user.attributes.org_id -> user.attributes.org). Backfill job wasn't executed for some tenants due to filter bug.

maria: that explains it. policy rules reference attributes.org now, so existing bindings with org_id are invisible. Can we backfill quickly for helio-23?

tiana: I can run a targeted migration. Will need the DB read replica and a short maintenance window for writes to role_bindings table.
ajay: customer is blocked — can we do a fast mitigation (support role grant) while migration runs?

sam: yes — we have an emergency support override role (support:tenant_admin) we can grant via admin API. I'll run it once we confirm the account.

helpdesk-bot: helio-23 reported via support ticket #15422. Contact: laura@heliohealth.com.

maria: steps for mitigation documented below. Keep it minimal: 1) grant support:tenant_admin to laura (email) 2) run targeted backfill for helio-23 3) revoke support role once verified.

sam: executing grant now. API: 
```
POST /internal/admin/grant_role
{
  "principal": "user:laura@heliohealth.com",
  "role": "support:tenant_admin",
  "scope": "org:helio-23",
  "reason": "emergency support - RBAC attribute rename"
}
```

sam: grant succeeded :white_check_mark:

ajay: told customer to try API key creation and model list. Waiting on confirmation.

laura (via support): can list models now, billing page still 403 though.

maria: billing permissions are checked against billing.viewer role which also relied on attributes.org. I'll start the backfill so both model and billing policies pick up their bindings.

tiana: running targeted backfill script on auth-db-replica-2 in read-write patch window. Script: 
```
UPDATE role_bindings
SET attributes = jsonb_set(attributes, '{org}', attributes->'org_id')
WHERE attributes ? 'org_id' AND scope = 'org:helio-23';
```

tiana: executing...

ops-bot: migration job started (job-id: backfill-helio-23-2174501234)

ajay: customer on call, wants ETA.

tiana: should be ~30s, tiny tenant.

ops-bot: migration job completed in 12s. Rows updated: 6.

maria: after backfill we need to invalidate policy cache for helio-23. Sam, can you push a cache invalidation?

sam: running cache purge for org:helio-23 -> /internal/policy/cache/purge?scope=org:helio-23

sam: purge OK.

laura (via support): billing page accessible now, can create API key and deploy model. Thanks! :tada:

ajay: requested that we keep the support role until EOD and then revoke.

sam: revoking support role in 1 hour, will confirm.

maria: follow-up actions: 1) fix the backfill CI gate so future deploys run migration for tenants with attributes.org_id 2) add a preflight check in deploy that fails if role attribute rename is present without backfill 3) add an automated canary test that validates model list and billing page for a handful of tenants post-deploy.

tiana: opened GH issue: redwood/platform#9876 with proposed migration fix and preflight test details.

sam: support role revoked for laura@heliohealth.com — audit id revoke-2174501600.

ajay: customer confirmed full access after revoke. Closing ticket.

maria: lowering incident to resolved but will track remediation tasks. Adding to weekly security review.

ajay: thanks everyone. Documenting timeline and actions in incident notes: https://redwood-internal/incidents/2174501234-rbac-refactor-helio-23
